frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Traveller, your groove is extraordinary. You have our trust. Let us move forward...

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: As we climb, let me tell you more about Harmonius. Long ago, Harmonius was a silent void in the cosmos. The celestial Maoi, known as Primus, discovered the primal rhythm that resonated through the void. From this rhythm, he crafted the fundamental notes that birthed our world. The lineage of Primus continued, each Maoi adding layers to the symphony that shaped Harmonius.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Wow! So Harmonious was birthed from pure groove... Tell me more!

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Primus's son, Secundus, inherited his father's gift and expanded upon it. He introduced the concept of harmony, creating intricate patterns that interwove with Primus's primal rhythm. Under Secundus's guidance, the Maoi learned to balance individual melodies with the collective harmony, bringing a new dimension to our world.

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: After Secundus, Tertius rose to prominence. He was a visionary who saw the potential of collaboration. He invited other beings from across the cosmos, each with their unique sounds, to join our symphony. Harmonius became a melting pot of melodies, each contributing to the grand symphony. This is whom we call the Elder Maoi.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: But if the Elder Maoi is so powerful, why has he not fought against the Grand Composer?

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Unfortunately, the Grand Composer's silence has saddened him: he has lost all hope. Although, he holds the knowledge and wisdom to wield the Celestial Amp properly. With it, we can bring back the lost harmony and overthrow the Grand Composer's tyranny.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: I am determined help you bring back the harmony!

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Traveller, we have journeyed far, and the climb takes its toll on us. We must rest, but you, with your boundless groove, can continue.

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Indeed. We can go no further without your help. Please, lend us your vibe energy so we may regain our strength!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Of course, my friends. Take my energy, and let's restore the groove together.
